commands.name: stringn
arguments: 6 players: Try to protect your flags against being captured and capture the other players' flags at the same time!

commands.name: stringn
arguments: Secure your flags as well as possible - it can't hurt to have a few occupied defence towers for each flag!

commands.name: stringn
arguments: You can pay a reactivation tribute to the merchant in the middle of the land to ransom your flags!

commands.name: stringn
arguments: Build a ship as quickly as you can! Use it to find the merchant, your opponents and as much treasure as possible!

commands.name: stringn
arguments: You should let your merchant take a look in the other buildings in the middle - they may contain something of value ...

commands.name: stringn
arguments: You should pay quickly, before it gets too expensive:

commands.name: stringn
arguments: If you think this price is high, then you'd better just sit and wait for your doom:

commands.name: stringn
arguments: Fancy a couple of dragons? You have to collect them yourself on my island!

commands.name: stringn
arguments: You have food for the soldiers on a neighbouring island? Very well! Then pay:

commands.name: stringn
arguments: Need some house permits to erect buildings? Take a look at the chest near your main warehouse!

commands.name: stringn
arguments: - Find the merchant near the middle!

commands.name: stringn
arguments: - Ransom your lost flags from him!
